facts.text: Nanuku sits on the southern coast of Viti Levu, Fiji's largest island.
facts.excerpt: sits on the southern coast of Fiji's largest island of Viti Levu, it feels like a secluded private world of its own

facts.text: Nanuku is set on a private 500-acre coastal estate in Fiji.
facts.excerpt: A true tropical oasis situated on a private 500-acre coastal Fiji estate

facts.text: Nanuku's address is 11 Nanuku Drive in Pacific Harbour, Fiji.
facts.excerpt: 11 Nanuku Drive, PO Box 555, Pacific Harbour, Fiji Islands

facts.text: Nanuku opened in 2014.
facts.excerpt: Opened in 2014, Nanuku has a total of only 37 suites, villas, and luxe private residences.

facts.text: Nanuku's accommodation includes suites, villas and private residences.
facts.excerpt: Nanuku has a total of only 37 suites, villas, and luxe private residences

facts.text: The suites have vaulted thatched roofs and private terraces.
facts.excerpt: the suites, for instance, have vaulted thatched roofs and private terraces

facts.text: The largest residences have private plunge pools and elevated balconies that overlook the ocean.
facts.excerpt: are outfitted with private plunge pools and elevated balconies that overlook the ocean

facts.text: Massages are offered among the branches of a 70-year-old Dilo tree.
facts.excerpt: From a restorative massage among the branches of a 70-year-old Dilo tree and sunrise yoga

facts.text: Wellness options include sunrise yoga, high-energy workout classes and hikes.
facts.excerpt: sunrise yoga to high-energy workout classes and dramatic hikes with breathtaking views

facts.text: Guests can whitewater raft through black volcanic walls barely five meters apart.
facts.excerpt: Whitewater raft through black volcanic walls barely five meters apart

facts.text: Guests can hunt for crabs in dense mangrove forest and trek up sand dunes.
facts.excerpt: hunt for crabs in dense mangrove forest, and trek up soaring sand dunes

facts.text: Guests can snorkel Beqa Lagoon, paddle board or hike to a waterfall.
facts.excerpt: Snorkel the legendary Beqa Lagoon, hop on a paddle board, or hike to a breathtaking waterfall.

facts.text: Activities include zip-lining, surfing and cage-less bull shark diving.
facts.excerpt: Adrenaline junkies can book zip-lining, white water rafting, treks through waterfalls, surfing, and cage-less bull shark diving.

facts.text: Guests can help rehabilitate Nanuku's private coral reef by planting coral and mangroves with the resort's marine biologist.
facts.excerpt: Guests can also help rehabilitate Nanuku's own private coral reef by assisting in coral and mangrove planting with the resort's marine biologist.

facts.text: Nanuku has a private island used for half-day excursions for couples on a special offer.
facts.excerpt: Book four nights or more and enjoy a half-day excursion to our private island, just for the two of you.

facts.text: The restaurant serves fresh seafood caught in Beqa Lagoon and South Pacific specialties such as ivi chestnuts and peach palm hearts.
facts.excerpt: serves up fresh seafood caught right in Beqa Lagoon, along with South Pacific specialties like ivi chestnuts and peach palm hearts

facts.text: Guests can lounge poolside.
facts.excerpt: Lounge poolside, take a yoga class.
